title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin jumps 6.9 percent to $72,862 as US morning trade lifts spot and futures in tandem. Fear & Greed at 62 shows greed building but not yet overheated.

Hashrate anchors at 782.1 EH/s, confirming miner conviction. Mempool holds 86,309 transactions with a 6 sat/vB floor, keeping the chain fluid ahead of block 963,334.

No fresh catalysts in the tape. Price action now keys on whether momentum clears 73k resistance before profit-taking sets in.
